mel_indicator_baselines_value_present_ch.name: mel_indicator_baselines_value_present_check
mel_indicator_baselines_value_present_ch.value: "mel_indicator_baselines"."value" IS NOT NULL OR "mel_indicator_baselines"."value_text" IS NOT NULL

mel_indicator_targets_value_present_chec.name: mel_indicator_targets_value_present_check
mel_indicator_targets_value_present_chec.value: "mel_indicator_targets"."value" IS NOT NULL OR "mel_indicator_targets"."value_text" IS NOT NULL

mel_monitoring_finance_entries_other_des.name: mel_monitoring_finance_entries_other_description_check
mel_monitoring_finance_entries_other_des.value:
("mel_monitoring_finance_entries"."finance_type" = 'other' AND NULLIF(BTRIM("mel_monitoring_finance_entries"."other_description"), '') IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("mel_monitoring_finance_entries"."finance_type" <> 'other' AND "mel_monitoring_finance_entries"."other_description" IS NULL)

mel_monitoring_jobs_valid_breakdown_chec.name: mel_monitoring_jobs_valid_breakdown_check
mel_monitoring_jobs_valid_breakdown_chec.value:
("mel_monitoring_jobs"."quarterly_total" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."quarterly_total" >= 0)
        AND ("mel_monitoring_jobs"."male" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."male" >= 0)
        AND ("mel_monitoring_jobs"."female" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."female" >= 0)
        AND ("mel_monitoring_jobs"."youth" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."youth" >= 0)
        AND ("mel_monitoring_jobs"."plwd" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."plwd" >= 0)
        AND ("mel_monitoring_jobs"."refugee" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."refugee" >= 0)
        AND ("mel_monitoring_jobs"."quarterly_total" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."male" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."female" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."male" + "mel_monitoring_jobs"."female" = "mel_monitoring_jobs"."quarterly_total")
        AND ("mel_monitoring_jobs"."quarterly_total" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."youth" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."youth" <= "mel_monitoring_jobs"."quarterly_total")
        AND ("mel_monitoring_jobs"."quarterly_total" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."plwd" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."plwd" <= "mel_monitoring_jobs"."quarterly_total")
        AND ("mel_monitoring_jobs"."quarterly_total" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."refugee" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_jobs"."refugee" <= "mel_monitoring_jobs"."quarterly_total")

mel_monitoring_responses_non_negative_fi.name: mel_monitoring_responses_non_negative_financials_check
mel_monitoring_responses_non_negative_fi.value:
("mel_monitoring_responses"."revenue" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_responses"."revenue" >= 0)
        AND ("mel_monitoring_responses"."costs" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_responses"."costs" >= 0)
        AND ("mel_monitoring_responses"."finance_value" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_responses"."finance_value" >= 0)
        AND ("mel_monitoring_responses"."circular_growth_value" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_responses"."circular_growth_value" >= 0)
        AND ("mel_monitoring_responses"."strategic_partnership_count" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_responses"."strategic_partnership_count" >= 0)
        AND ("mel_monitoring_responses"."new_market_segments" IS NULL OR "mel_monitoring_responses"."new_market_segments" >= 0)

mel_programme_results_value_present_chec.name: mel_programme_results_value_present_check
mel_programme_results_value_present_chec.value: "mel_programme_results"."value" IS NOT NULL OR "mel_programme_results"."value_text" IS NOT NULL OR ("mel_programme_results"."numerator" IS NOT NULL AND "mel_programme_results"."denominator" IS NOT NULL)
